---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use on first run after import: set up the daily combined morning brief by
  asking the new owner four questions, one at a time.
---
# Getting started

Say in one line what you do: every day I send one combined morning brief in this chat, mainly what the X accounts you follow posted, sorted by the topics you care about, and I can archive it to Notion or Obsidian. Then ask one question at a time and wait for each answer.

1. Which topics or fields are you interested in? (These go first in the brief; anything you want skipped, say so too.)
2. Should I include what the accounts you follow on X post by default? If yes, ask for their X handle and permission to open their Following page once in my browser to build the list. They log in to X themselves; I never see passwords or codes. Do nothing on X until they say yes.
3. What time should the brief arrive each day? (Confirm their time zone.)
4. Where should I archive it: Notion (ask them to connect Notion and name the page or database), local Obsidian (ask which vault and folder, and which computer), or nowhere? Each post is saved as an X card: author, one-sentence gist, and the real link or embed.

Then:
- Save the answers as memories (topics, own handle to exclude, delivery time and zone, archive destination).
- If they agreed, read their Following page once, save the handle list to /workspace/x-following-list.json, and refresh it weekly.
- Create the daily morning-digest routine at their time, then run it once now so they see the first brief.
- Never post, like, reply, or send anything for them without them confirming the full text.

routines.name: morning-digest
routines.description: Fires daily at the owner's chosen time to deliver one combined morning brief.
routines.content:
Send the owner one combined morning brief in this chat, in their preferred language. Leave out any section that is empty entirely.

X following: load the handle list from /workspace/x-following-list.json (refresh weekly, or when unreadable, by reading the owner's Following page in the browser). Using the free native `x` namespace only, group handles into `(from:a OR from:b ...) -is:retweet` queries covering the last 24 hours, page until there is no next_token, dedupe by post ID keeping only the latest edit, and fetch full text for long posts with get_posts_by_ids. Include replies but say who each reply is to, with a short gist if that account isn't followed. Exclude the owner's own account and spam replies. Put the owner's priority topics first, then group the rest by theme; one line per post: @handle, one-sentence gist, real link. Lead with 2–3 top points.

Optional sections only if the owner connected them: important unread email (summaries plus links, never reply).

Archive: if the owner chose Notion or Obsidian, save the X section as a dated note where each post is an X card (author, gist, real link or embed). Never overwrite an existing file.

Never post, like, reply, or send anything; never invent content.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Asia/Singapore 58 9 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
